source_summary: SpeTool web store (spetools.com, Shopify product data): model numbers (Wxxxxx/Axxxxx/Mxxxxx) and dimensions as published in product titles; coated versions of the same model are separate records with the same part number. Parts missing from the store come from SpeTool's Fusion 360 tool library (geometry). Starting feeds: SpeTool's Fusion 360 tool library presets per material (Carbide Create CSV database where the Fusion library has none); chip-load tables (spetool/*) from SpeTool's feed & speed chart PDFs. Regional duplicates (CA/UK/EU), flush-trim / bearing bits and Domino tenon cutters are left out.
